Thanks Sarah — great to meet Acme on the call. Looping in Karthik from Partner Ops to confirm the exact mechanics. High level:

- We do accept email introductions as initial evidence, but we require a short registration form to lock the claim (the intake is just a one-paragraph submission plus contact info).
- Standard claim window is 18 months from registration for referral credit; if CloudNova is co-seller with active participation, commission bands differ (higher for pure referral, different for co-sell).
- If CloudNova runs the discovery/demo but isn't the primary contracting party, that still qualifies as a referral as long as the registration is complete before Redwood engages procurement.

Karthik — can you confirm the registration link, the required fields, and the commission band matrix that would apply if CloudNova leads the discovery vs co-sell? Also calling out the attached MSA version that Sarah sent — we may need procurement to review if Acme requests vendor redlines.

Quick answer summarizing policy and next steps — copying the intake checklist below so Sarah has everything in one place.

Policy highlights (short):
- Registration: Submit the partner lead intake form (link below) before Redwood sends the first proposal or engages procurement formally. We accept email intros for initial submission but the form locks the registration.
- Claim window: 18 months from registration for referrals; for co-sell arrangements the crediting and payout cadence are governed by the co-sell matrix and may require a signed co-sell addendum.
- Eligibility: Partner must certify they did not sell the product directly to the same end-customer in the past 12 months and that the lead was introduced by a named partner contact.

Commission bands (examples):
- Referral (partner passes lead, Redwood closes): 8% of first-year net ARR payout (subject to clawback 12 months).
- Co-sell (partner actively participates, joint demos, credit split): 12% total first-year net ARR split per negotiated split (standard 60/40 in favor of Redwood unless otherwise approved).

Intake checklist / Required fields (one-paragraph + attachments):
1) Prospective company name, point of contact email/phone, region
2) Short summary of intro (how partner engaged the buyer)
3) Expected timeline and current stage (discovery/demo/procurement)
4) Any existing docs (SOW, RFP, procurement contact)
5) Attachments: CSV or contact card

Registration link: https://partners.redwood.com/lead-intake (internal)
HubSpot note template: partner-intro | use tag: cloudnova-intro-D-83421-CNV

Next steps for CloudNova / Acme flow:
- Sarah: please submit the intake form and upload the SOW_v1 and the contact CSV. If you prefer, we can submit on your behalf with your permission (just reply OK).
- Mateo / Marissa: we'll triage whether procurement review is needed for the MSA — if Acme requests redlines we will route to Legal and update CloudNova on potential timing impact.
